'''Steepara syrup''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that formed a part of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] diet. Like most of the rest of the Dressellians' foods, the [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] was provided by [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel's]] [[steepara tree]]s.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
